paragraphs: R' Elazar bar Menachem: [Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1, folio 5b](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.1.1.27). Menashya bar Menachem: [Shabbat 144b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.144b.1-4).[^3]

notes.text: The [printed page](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/ba/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._III._1910.pdf#page=56) gives II Kings 15:14 and Vayikra Rabbah 1:13. The supplied transcription has 9:14 and ד״ג respectively.
Sotah reads Isi ben Menachem. In the Yerushalmi, Rabbi Pinchas speaks in the name of Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Menachem.
Shabbat uses both bar and ben Menachem in the discussion of the household’s practice of squeezing pomegranates.
